desc:
⚾ Step up to the plate and become the star of the game!
No more waiting around for your turn to bat or pitch. Jump straight into the action and take control from the very first pitch.

🔥 A fast-paced 1-on-1 baseball showdown focused entirely on pitching and batting — no fielding, no downtime.
⏰ Games last only 3 innings, meaning every pitch, every swing, and every decision matters.
🏆 To claim victory, you'll need to dominate on both sides of the ball as an elite hitter and an elite pitcher.
⚡ Experience the ultimate two-way baseball battle!

💻 PC
• Pitching: WASD to aim + Pitch button to throw
• Batting: Move the PCI with your mouse + Left Click to swing

📱 Mobile
• Pitching: Drag on the screen to aim + Pitch button to throw
• Batting: Drag on the screen to move your Aim Cursor + Swing button to hit

🚧 Early Access: This game is still in active development.
Bugs may occur, and features may change as we continue adding updates and improvements.
